item.title: Compass, NWMLS clash over document production in antitrust suit
item.description: Compass accuses NWMLS of delaying document production in their antitrust lawsuit, with trial now set for October 2026.

item.title: Why didn’t double-digit growth in purchase apps lead to more home sales in 2025?
item.description: Despite double-digit growth in purchase applications for much of 2025, existing home sales increased only modestly from 2024.

item.title: Bank statement loans: More mortgage options for self-employed buyers and homeowners as rates ease
item.description: If you’re self-employed, paid on commission, or run a business, you already know the frustration: you can have strong cash flow, great credit, and real assets—yet a traditional mortgage can still feel like a square peg in a round hole.

item.title: WFG’s Don O’Neill on FinCEN, rate scrutiny and title compliance
item.description: From looming FinCEN requirements to rate reductions and licensing pressures, compliance teams are preparing for sweeping changes.

item.title: Innovations in reverse mortgage lending will drive growth in 2026
item.description: The reverse mortgage market is expected to grow in 2026 as lenders innovate with new offerings and adapt to the interest rate environment.

item.title: Pending home sales rise in November as lower rates spur buyers
item.description: Pending home sales rose 3.3% in November, with NAR’s index hitting a reading of 79.2, and all regions posting monthly and annual gains.

item.title: RMLS Alliance becomes Broker Public Portal shareholder, expands reach via Cribio
item.description: RMLS Alliance joins Broker Public Portal as a shareholder, making the listings for 1,600 agents available on Cribio in Illinois.

item.title: How long does it take to save for a down payment in 2025?
item.description: Homebuyers now need seven years to save for a down payment, down from 12 years in 2022, but high-cost metros remain further out of reach.

item.title: Rechat partners with SkySlope to add forms, e-signatures to platform
item.description: Rechat’s partnership with SkySlope adds digital forms, MLS data synchronization and e-signatures to its platform, centralizing agent workflows.

item.title: Realtor.com urges action on US housing supply shortage
item.description: Realtor.com’s Let America Build campaign urges lawmakers to address housing supply as U.S. inventory stays 4 million short.
